asserts.sidesFit: P1 (my definition). With the Sides popover of `field` (Padding or Margin) open: for each side the number input named `<field> <side>` (lower-case side) has a stepper box (the smallest ancestor of the input that also contains its two buttons named `Decrease <field> <side>` and `Increase <field> <side>`), a cell (the child of the popover that contains the input) and label boxes (every element of the cell outside the stepper that has text of its own). (a) the cell, the stepper, its three controls and every label box lie inside the popover's border box, 1 px; (b) the popover lies inside the window, 0.5 px; (c) it lies inside the editor card ([data-editor]) left to right, 1 px; (d) the document does not scroll sideways (scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 0.5); (e) the four stepper boxes have equal widths, 1 px; (f) no label box overlaps a button of its stepper (overlap area under 0.5 px squared; touching edges are allowed).
asserts.fontList: P5 (my definition). The select named `label`: a SELECT; its first option shows the first family name of the computed font-family of `sel` (quotes stripped); the next options are `list` in order, each with exactly that label and that value; the first len(originals) of them are `originals`, in order; no option label contains a comma or a quote; independently of `list`: every option value after the first ends in one of the generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace, cursive, fantasy, system-ui) and every name inside a value that contains a space is double-quoted.
asserts.css: as before (equals: the computed value as a string).
asserts.exportHas: as before (P2: the regular expression is matched against the exported file).
